selection_rule: Retain configurations within 0.01 of the best defined validation Spearman within the comparison, then maximize defined high-fitness validation Spearman. For remaining ties favor Count-only, Ridge, then Random Forest. Within a family prefer higher Ridge alpha or fewer and shallower trees with larger leaves and fewer candidate features. Undefined correlations rank last. If every overall Spearman is undefined, compare all configs on high-fitness Spearman and simplicity.
top_k_tie_breaking: SHA-256 of seed:experiment_variant_id; independent of observed fitness
test_and_candidate_input_hashes: Recorded in evaluation_summary.json after this selection is saved.
